HINT_RIPPS2_FAST_BOOT: Boot reads RIPPS2's own drive only: the settings and the sounds beside RIPPS2.ELF (RIPPS2.FB there says where) and every list from its cache. The other drives wait: SELECT on a page starts its drives and brings their art (with Automatic Refresh on they start at boot). Turning it on copies your sounds, and the music when there is room, into AUDIO beside RIPPS2.
